meaning:
ἐκ-κρέμαννυμι,
[in LXX for קָשַׁר, Gen.44:30 * ;]
to hang from or upon; mid., ἐκκρέμαμαι: figuratively, ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ άκούων (Rec.; WH read ἐξεκρέμετο, which implies a Pres. ἐκκρέμομαι, otherwise unknown; cf. Veitch, see word κρέμαμαι), Luk.19:48.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
